title: Psalm 51:1-4,9-15 501a /
firstLine: God be merciful to me; on Thy grace I rest my plea; in Thy vast abounding grace, my transgressions all erase. Wash me wholly from my sin; cleanse from every ill within.

lines: God be merciful to me; on Thy grace I rest my plea; in Thy vast abounding grace, my transgressions all erase. Wash me wholly from my sin; cleanse from every ill within.
For my sins before me rise, ever-present to my eyes. I have sinned 'gainst Thee alone, in Thy sight this evil done; that Thy judgment may be clear, and Thy sentence just appear.
From my sins hide Thou Thy face; my iniquities erase. O my god, renew my heart, and a spirit right impart. Cast me not away from Thee, nor Thy Spirit take from me.
Give salvation's joy again, and a willing mind sustain. Then Thy perfect ways I'll show, that transgressors them may know; Open Thou my lips O Lord, then my mouth shall praise accord.
